blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – GenCorp Industries Inc. Corporate Counsel Suzette Balucanag-Punay admitted on Wednesday questioning the company’s payments to Vice President Sara Duterte worth P2 million from 2022 to 2025. Earlier, Balucanag-Punay herself testified that GenCorp had been disbursing money to the vice president as “returns” from a “loose investment” to Davao Bounty Times Food Corp. particularly her alleged investment into a Jollibee Time Square branch in 2007. But Presiding officer Francis Escudero pointed out that the branch of the fast food chain never ended up with Davao Bounty Times, and instead was operated by Great Jolly Times Food Corp. – a […]...
